AbolishPipelineRun.description_en: Calls this operation to change the status of a specified deployment process to terminated. The deployment process is not deleted and can still be queried through query operations
AbolishPipelineRun.description_zh: 调用该接口，会将指定发布流程的状态变更为终止状态，但不会删除这个发布流程，仍然可以通过查询接口查询到

AddEntityIntoMetaCollection.description_en: Adds a specified entity object to a Data Map collection. The collection object can be a Data Map category or a data album. The entity object currently supports only the data table type. To add an entity to a data album, the caller must have the AliyunDataWorksFullAccess permission, or be the creator or administrator of the album
AddEntityIntoMetaCollection.description_zh:
向数据地图集合中添加给定实体对象，集合对象支持数据地图类目和数据专辑两种，实体对象当前仅支持数据表类型。
向数据专辑添加实体时，要求调用者具有AliyunDataWorksFullAccess 权限，或者为专辑的创建者或管理员

ApplyResourceAccessPermission.description_en: Commits an access permissions request for specific resources
ApplyResourceAccessPermission.description_zh: 用于提交对特定资源的访问权限申请

ApproveProcessInstance.description_en: Approves or rejects a specified approval process instance
ApproveProcessInstance.description_zh: 用于对指定的审批流程实例进行同意或拒绝操作

AssociateProjectToImage.description_en: Associates an image with a workspace

AssociateProjectToResourceGroup.description_en: Associates a resource group with a workspace
AssociateProjectToResourceGroup.description_zh: 绑定资源组到某个工作空间

AttachDataQualityRulesToEvaluationTask.description_en: Associates data quality rules with a data quality check task
AttachDataQualityRulesToEvaluationTask.description_zh: 把数据质量规则关联到数据质量校验任务上

BatchCreateMetaEntities.description_en: Creates metadata entities in batches. All entities in the same batch must be of the same type. Currently, only custom entity types and extension table types (corresponding to Database/Table) are supported
BatchCreateMetaEntities.description_zh: 批量创建元数据实体，同一批次需要为同一种类型，当前仅支持纯自定义类型和扩展表类型（对应Database/Table）

BatchDeleteMetaEntities.description_en: Deletes metadata entity objects in batches. Supports deleting custom entities and extension table type objects (Database/Table). Does not support deleting columns individually. You can delete associated Column objects by deleting the Table
BatchDeleteMetaEntities.description_zh: 批量删除元数据实体对象，支持删除创建的纯自定义实体，扩展表类型对象(Database/Table)，不支持单独删除column，可以通过删除Table,删除关联Column对象

BatchUpdateTasks.description_en: Updates multiple nodes in batches by using incremental updates
BatchUpdateTasks.description_zh: 以增量更新的方式，批量更新多个任务

CancelAgentSession.description_en: Interrupts the Agent call for a specified session, supporting interruption during streaming responses
CancelAgentSession.description_zh: 用于中断指定会话的Agent调用，支持流式响应中断

CloneDataSource.description_en: Clones a new data source based on an existing data source
CloneDataSource.description_zh: 根据已有的数据源，克隆一条新的数据源

CreateAgentSession.description_en: Creates a new agent session and returns the session ID
CreateAgentSession.description_zh: 创建一个新的Agent会话并返回会话ID

CreateAlertRule.description_en: Creates a custom monitoring alert rule
CreateAlertRule.description_zh: 创建自定义监控告警规则

CreateBusiness.description_en: Creates a business process in DataStudio for data development
CreateBusiness.description_zh: 调用CreateBusiness，创建数据开发（DataStudio）的业务流程

CreateComputeResource.description_en: Creates a compute resource in a specified workspace. The compute resource can be in the development environment or production environment
CreateComputeResource.description_zh: 在指定项目空间创建一条计算资源，可以是开发环境或生产环境

CreateCrawler.description_en: Creates a metadata crawler and configures the data source, collection scope, resource group, and scheduling method
CreateCrawler.description_zh: 创建一个元数据采集器，并配置数据源、采集范围、资源组和调度方式

CreateDIAlarmRule.description_en: Creates an alert rule for a data integration task
CreateDIAlarmRule.description_zh: 创建数据集成报警规则

CreateDIJob.description_zh: 创建数据集成新版任务

CreateDataQualityAlertRule.description_en: Creates a data quality monitoring alert rule in a specified project
CreateDataQualityAlertRule.description_zh: 用于在指定项目中创建数据质量监控告警规则

CreateDataQualityEvaluationTask.description_en: Creates a DataWorks data quality monitor

CreateDataQualityEvaluationTaskInstance.description_en: Creates a data quality check task instance
CreateDataQualityEvaluationTaskInstance.description_zh: 创建数据质量校验任务实例

CreateDataQualityScanRun.description_en: Triggers the execution of a specified data quality monitoring task and returns the run instance ID
CreateDataQualityScanRun.description_zh: 触发指定数据质量监控任务的执行，并返回运行实例ID

CreateDataQualityTemplate.description_en: Creates a data quality rule template in a specified project
CreateDataQualityTemplate.description_zh: 用于在指定项目中创建新的数据质量规则模板

CreateDataSource.description_en: Creates a data source in a specified project workspace for the development or production environment
CreateDataSource.description_zh: 在指定项目空间创建一条数据源，可以是开发环境或生产环境

CreateDataSourceSharedRule.description_en: Creates a sharing rule for a data source to share it with other workspaces or RAM users
CreateDataSourceSharedRule.description_zh: 创建一条数据源分享规则，即将数据源分享给其他空间或者子账号使用

CreateDataset.description_en: Creates a dataset. You can create a dataset only in a workspace that you have joined. Only DataWorks datasets are supported. The maximum number of datasets per tenant is 2000
CreateDataset.description_zh:
创建数据集，仅支持在用户已加入的工作空间创建数据集
且当前仅支持创建DataWorks数据集，单租户下限制数据集最大数量为2000

CreateDatasetVersion.description_en: Creates a dataset version. Currently, only DataWorks datasets are supported. The maximum number of versions is 20
CreateDatasetVersion.description_zh: 创建数据集版本，当前仅支持DataWorks数据集，支持最大版本数为20

CreateFile.description_en: Creates a file in DataStudio. This operation does not support creating Data Integration nodes
CreateFile.description_zh: 调用CreateFile，在数据开发中创建一个文件。目前不支持调用该接口创建数据集成节点任务

CreateFunction.description_en: Creates a UDF function in DataStudio. The UDF function information is described in FlowSpec format
CreateFunction.description_zh: 调用此接口，可以在数据开发中创建一个udf函数。udf函数信息以FlowSpec格式描述

CreateLineageRelationship.description_en: Registers a data lineage relationship in DataWorks Data Map. You can use this operation to establish lineage relationships between metadata entities managed by DataWorks, including table-to-table, column-to-column, table-to-column, and dataset-to-table scenarios. You can also establish lineage relationships between managed entities and custom entity objects registered by users. This operation is compatible with non-managed custom objects, but this approach is no longer recommended. Before calling this operation, make sure that the managed entities involved in the lineage registration already exist on the DataWorks platform
CreateLineageRelationship.description_zh: 注册数据地图的血缘关系。通过此接口，可以在 DataWorks 纳管元数据实体之间建立血缘关系，包括表与表、字段与字段、表与字段、数据集与表等场景；也可以在纳管实体与用户自行注册的自定义实体对象之间建立血缘关系。接口兼容非纳管自定义对象，但该方式已不再推荐。调用前需确保参与血缘注册的纳管实体已存在于 DataWorks 平台

CreateMetaCollection.description_en: Creates a collection in Data Map. Collections include categories, subcategories, data albums, and categories that are created in the data albums
CreateMetaCollection.description_zh: 创建数据地图集合对象，支持创建数据地图类目（包括多级子类目）、数据专辑（专辑子类目）两种类型的集合对象

CreateMetaEntityDef.description_en: Creates a metadata entity definition, including custom types and extended table types
CreateMetaEntityDef.description_zh: 创建元数据实体定义（包括纯自定义类型和扩展表类型）

CreateNetwork.description_en: Creates a network and associates the network with a general resource group
CreateNetwork.description_zh: 创建并绑定通用资源组网络资源

CreateNode.description_en: Creates a data development node in the new version of DataStudio
CreateNode.description_zh: 调用该接口，会在新版数据开发中创建一个数据开发节点

CreatePipelineRun.description_en: Creates a publish process for an entity in the new-version DataStudio
CreatePipelineRun.description_zh: 调用此接口，可以对新版数据开发中的实体创建一个发布流程

CreateProcessDefinition.description_en: Creates a new approval process definition, supporting custom configuration of approval rules and notification services
CreateProcessDefinition.description_zh: 用于创建新的审批流程定义，支持自定义配置审批规则和通知服务

CreateProjectMember.description_en: Adds a workspace member and grants workspace roles to the member
CreateProjectMember.description_zh: 添加工作空间成员同时授予工作空间角色

CreateProjectRole.description_en: Creates a custom role for a workspace
CreateProjectRole.description_zh: 新建工作空间自定义角色

CreateResource.description_en: Creates a file resource for data development. The file resource information is defined in FlowSpec format
CreateResource.description_zh: 调用此接口，可以在数据开发中创建一个数据开发文件资源，文件资源的信息定义以FlowSpec格式描述

CreateResourceFile.description_en: Supports users in specifying their own files (such as JAR, PY, archive, or file) to create Data Development resource files
CreateResourceFile.description_zh: 支持用户指定自己的文件（比如jar，py，arhive，file等）创建数据开发资源文件

CreateRoute.description_en: Creates a route for a network

CreateSecurityStrategy.description_en: Creates a new security control policy to configure various modules and submodules. Requires both DataWorks tenant administrator and security administrator permissions
CreateSecurityStrategy.description_zh: 用于创建新的安全管控策略，支持多种模块和子模块配置。需要Dataworks 租户管理员与安全管理员权限

CreateSemanticJob.description_en: Saves a reusable semantic job definition. If you use a single-file source, apply for and complete the attachment upload first. After creation, call RunSemanticJob with the returned Name
CreateSemanticJob.description_zh: 保存可复用的语义任务定义。若使用单文件来源，请先申请并完成附件上传；创建成功后用返回的 Name 调用 RunSemanticJob

CreateServerIdeInstance.description_en: Creates a personal development environment instance
CreateServerIdeInstance.description_zh: 创建个人开发环境实例

CreateSkill.description_en: Creates a new Skill in DataWorks
CreateSkill.description_zh: 用于在 DataWorks 中创建一个新的 Skill

CreateUdfFile.description_en: Creates a file for a function in DataStudio
CreateUdfFile.description_zh: 调用CreateUdfFile，在数据开发中创建函数类型文件

CreateWorkflowDefinition.description_en: Creates a workflow in a specified folder in DataStudio
CreateWorkflowDefinition.description_zh: 调用该接口，在数据开发指定目录下创建一个工作流

CreateWorkflowInstances.description_en: Creates a workflow instance based on configurations, such as a data backfill workflow instance
CreateWorkflowInstances.description_zh: 根据配置创建工作流实例，如补数据工作流实例

DeleteAlertRule.description_en: Deletes a custom monitoring alert rule
DeleteAlertRule.description_zh: 删除自定义监控报警规则

DeleteComputeResource.description_en: Deletes the specified computing resource based on the computing resource ID
DeleteComputeResource.description_zh: 根据计算资源ID，删除指定的计算资源

DeleteCrawler.description_zh: 删除指定的元数据采集器

DeleteDIAlarmRule.description_en: Deletes an alert rule configured for a synchronization task
DeleteDIAlarmRule.description_zh: 删除数据集成报警规则

DeleteDIJob.description_zh: 删除数据集成新版任务

DeleteDataQualityAlertRule.description_en: Deletes a data quality monitoring alert rule based on the specified ID
DeleteDataQualityAlertRule.description_zh: 根据指定的ID删除数据质量监控告警规则

DeleteDataQualityEvaluationTask.description_en: Deletes a data quality monitoring task
DeleteDataQualityEvaluationTask.description_zh: 删除数据质量校验任务

DeleteDataQualityRule.description_en: Deletes a data quality monitoring rule

DeleteDataQualityRuleTemplate.description_en: Deletes a custom data quality rule template
DeleteDataQualityRuleTemplate.description_zh: 删除自定义质量规则模版

DeleteDataQualityTemplate.description_en: Deletes a data quality rule template by ID
DeleteDataQualityTemplate.description_zh: 根据指定ID删除数据质量规则模板

DeleteDataSource.description_en: Deletes a data source by data source ID
DeleteDataSource.description_zh: 根据数据源ID，删除指定的数据源

DeleteDataSourceSharedRule.description_en: Deletes a data source sharing rule by rule ID
DeleteDataSourceSharedRule.description_zh: 根据数据源分享规则ID，删除一条数据源分享规则

DeleteDataset.description_en: Deletes a dataset. Only DataWorks datasets are supported. The corresponding dataset versions are cascade deleted. The operator must be the creator of the dataset or an administrator of the workspace to which the dataset belongs
DeleteDataset.description_zh: 删除数据集，仅支持删除DataWorks数据集，级联删除对应的数据集版本，要求操作者为数据集的创建者或数据集所在工作空间的管理员

DeleteDatasetVersion.description_en: Deletes a dataset version. Only non-v1 DataWorks dataset versions can be deleted by using this operation. To delete a v1 dataset version, use the DeleteDataset operation. The operator must be the creator of the dataset or an administrator of the workspace to which the dataset belongs
DeleteDatasetVersion.description_zh:
删除数据集版本，仅支持删除DataWorks非v1版本数据集，v1版本数据集需要通过DeleteDataset接口完成删除
要求操作者为数据集的创建者或数据集所在工作空间的管理员

DeleteFile.description_en: Deletes a file from DataStudio. If the file has been committed, an asynchronous process is triggered to delete the file in the scheduling system. The value of the DeploymentId parameter returned is used to call the GetDeployment operation to poll the status of the asynchronous process
DeleteFile.description_zh: 调用DeleteFile删除数据开发中的文件。如果文件已经提交过，那么DeleteFile API会同时触发一个异步在调度系统删除的流程，需要用DeleteFile  API返回的DeploymentId继续调用GetDeployment轮询被触发的异步删除流程的状态

DeleteFolder.description_en: Invoke DeleteFolder to delete a folder on the Data Development page
DeleteFolder.description_zh: 调用DeleteFolder删除数据开发页面的文件夹

DeleteFunction.description_en: Deletes a user-defined function (UDF) in DataStudio
DeleteFunction.description_zh: 调用该接口，在数据开发中删除指定的udf函数

DeleteLineageRelationship.description_en: Deletes a specified data lineage relationship from DataWorks Data Map
DeleteLineageRelationship.description_zh: 删除给定的数据地图血缘关系

DeleteMetaCollection.description_en:
Delete a collection object in the specified Data Map, including Data Map categories and data albums.
When deleting a data album, the caller must have the AliyunDataWorksFullAccess permission or be the creator or administrator of the album
DeleteMetaCollection.description_zh:
删除给定数据地图中的集合对象，包括数据地图类目和数据专辑。
删除数据专辑时，要求调用者具有AliyunDataWorksFullAccess 权限，或者为专辑的创建者或管理员

DeleteMetaEntityDef.description_en: Deletes a metadata entity definition, including custom entity types and extension table types
DeleteMetaEntityDef.description_zh: 删除元数据实体定义（包含纯自定义类型和扩展表类型）

DeleteNetwork.description_en: Disassociates and deletes a network resource from a general-purpose resource group
DeleteNetwork.description_zh: 解绑并删除通用资源组网络资源

DeleteNode.description_en: Deletes a specified data development node
DeleteNode.description_zh: 调用此接口，可以删除指定的数据开发节点

DeleteProcessDefinition.description_en: Deletes a process definition by the specified ID
DeleteProcessDefinition.description_zh: 根据指定的ID删除一个审批流程定义

DeleteProject.description_zh: 调用DeleteProject接口，删除DataWorks工作空间

DeleteProjectMember.description_en: Removes a workspace member and the workspace roles granted to the member
DeleteProjectMember.description_zh: 移除工作空间成员及其已授予的工作空间角色

DeleteProjectRole.description_en: Deletes a custom role from a workspace

DeleteResource.description_en: Deletes a file resource from DataStudio
DeleteResource.description_zh: 调用此接口，可以删除指定的数据开发文件资源

DeleteRoute.description_en: Deletes a route from a network resource

DeleteSecurityStrategy.description_en: Deletes a security strategy by its ID. To call this operation, you must have DataWorks tenant administrator and security administrator permissions
DeleteSecurityStrategy.description_zh: 根据指定ID删除一个安全策略。需要Dataworks 租户管理员与安全管理员权限

DeleteSemanticJob.description_en: Deletes a semantic job definition by the Name of a created job. If the job is currently running, call KillSemanticJob with the ExecutorJobId of that run and confirm the stop before deletion
DeleteSemanticJob.description_zh: 按已创建任务的 Name 删除任务定义。任务正在运行时，先用该运行的 ExecutorJobId 调用 KillSemanticJob 并确认停止

DeleteServerIdeInstance.description_en: Deletes a specified personal development environment instance
DeleteServerIdeInstance.description_zh: 删除指定的个人开发环境实例

DeleteWorkflowDefinition.description_en: Deletes a specified workflow in data development
DeleteWorkflowDefinition.description_zh: 调用该接口，在数据开发中删除指定的工作流

DeployFile.description_en: Deploys a file to the production environment

DetachDataQualityRulesFromEvaluationTask.description_en: Removes the association between a data quality rule and a data quality monitoring task
DetachDataQualityRulesFromEvaluationTask.description_zh: 取消数据质量规则和数据质量校验任务的关联

DisableProcessDefinition.description_en: Disables the specified approval process definition
DisableProcessDefinition.description_zh: 通过指定的流程定义ID来停用一个审批流程定义

DissociateProjectFromImage.description_en: Disassociates an image from a workspace
DissociateProjectFromImage.description_zh: 解除镜像与工作空间的关联

DissociateProjectFromResourceGroup.description_en: Disassociates a resource group from a workspace
DissociateProjectFromResourceGroup.description_zh: 将资源组和某个工作空间解除绑定

DownloadSemanticResults.description_en: Returns the download URL of artifacts by job name and an optional run ID after a run completes. If JobRunId is not specified, the results of the most recent run of the job are returned
DownloadSemanticResults.description_zh: 在运行结束后，按任务名称和可选运行标识返回产物下载地址；不传 JobRunId 时返回该任务最新一次运行的结果

EnableProcessDefinition.description_en: Enables a process definition with the specified ID
EnableProcessDefinition.description_zh: 用于启用指定ID的审批流程定义

EstablishRelationTableToBusiness.description_en: Imports a table to a workflow. The call to this API operation is equivalent to performing the following operations: Go to the DataStudio page, find the desired workflow, and then click the workflow name. Right-click Table under the desired folder and select Import Table
EstablishRelationTableToBusiness.description_zh: 相当于在数据开发页面右键单击业务流程，选择导入表的操作

ExecPipelineRunStage.description_en: Executes a specified stage of a publish flow
ExecPipelineRunStage.description_zh: 调用此接口，可以执行发布流程的指定阶段

ExecuteAdhocWorkflowInstance.description_en: Creates a temporary workflow instance based on the specified configuration
ExecuteAdhocWorkflowInstance.description_zh: 根据配置创建一个临时工作流实例

FindBestMatchSecurityStrategy.description_en: Find the security policy that best matches the given conditions
FindBestMatchSecurityStrategy.description_zh: 根据给定条件查找最匹配的安全策略

GetAgentSessionArtifactMeta.description_en: Retrieves the metadata and content of an artifact based on a session ID and artifact path
GetAgentSessionArtifactMeta.description_zh: 根据会话ID和文件路径获取Artifact的元信息及正文内容

GetAgentSessionTokenUsage.description_en: Retrieves the cumulative AI token usage for a specified session
GetAgentSessionTokenUsage.description_zh: 按SessionId聚合查询该会话累计的AIToken用量

GetAlertRule.description_en: Retrieves a custom monitoring alert rule
GetAlertRule.description_zh: 获取自定义监控告警规则

GetApplicationContents.description_en: Queries the content of resource permission applications under the specified process instance ID
GetApplicationContents.description_zh: 查询指定流程实例ID下的资源权限申请内容

GetBatchChangeTableOwnerStatus.description_en: Queries the status of a batch table owner transfer task

GetBusiness.description_en: Queries the details of a business process by calling GetBusiness
GetBusiness.description_zh: 调用GetBusiness查询业务流程的详情

GetCatalog.description_en: Retrieves the details of a specified data catalog in DataWorks Data Map. Currently, DLF and StarRocks catalog types are supported
GetCatalog.description_zh: 获取数据地图中给定数据目录的详情信息，当前支持dlf与starrocks类型

GetColumn.description_en: Retrieves the details of a specified column in a Data Map table
GetColumn.description_zh: 获取数据地图数据表给定字段的详细信息

GetComputeResource.description_en: Queries the specified computing resource based on the computing resource ID
GetComputeResource.description_zh: 根据计算资源ID，查询指定的计算资源

GetCrawler.description_en: Queries the configuration, status, and latest run information of a specified metadata crawler
GetCrawler.description_zh: 查询指定元数据采集器的配置、状态和最近一次运行信息

GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities.description_en: Queries the crawler types supported in the current region, along with their collection scope, scheduling, and extension configuration capabilities
GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities.description_zh: 查询当前地域支持创建的采集器类型及其采集范围、调度和扩展配置能力

GetCreateWorkflowInstancesResult.description_en: Queries the result of asynchronously creating a workflow instance
GetCreateWorkflowInstancesResult.description_zh: 查询异步创建工作流实例的结果

GetCustomAttribute.description_zh: 获取自定义属性定义详情

GetDIJobLog.description_en: Retrieves the task logs of a data integration node
GetDIJobLog.description_zh: 获取数据集成任务日志

GetDataQualityAlertRule.description_en: Retrieves the details of a data quality alert rule by rule ID
GetDataQualityAlertRule.description_zh: 根据告警规则ID查询对应的数据质量监控告警规则详情

GetDataQualityEvaluationTask.description_en: Query the details of a data quality validation task
GetDataQualityEvaluationTask.description_zh: 查询数据质量校验任务详情

GetDataQualityEvaluationTaskInstance.description_en: Retrieves the details of a data quality check task instance
GetDataQualityEvaluationTaskInstance.description_zh: 获取数据质量校验任务实例详情

GetDataQualityRule.description_en: Queries the details of a data quality rule

GetDataQualityRuleTemplate.description_en: Queries the details of a data quality rule template
GetDataQualityRuleTemplate.description_zh: 查询质量规则模版详情

GetDataQualityScan.description_zh: 获取数据质量监控详情

GetDataQualityScanRun.description_en: Creates a data quality monitoring run instance
GetDataQualityScanRun.description_zh: 创建数据质量监控运行实例

GetDataQualityScanRunLog.description_en: Queries the log content of a specified data quality monitoring task instance
GetDataQualityScanRunLog.description_zh: 查询指定数据质量监控任务实例的日志内容

GetDataQualityTemplate.description_en: Retrieves the details of a data quality rule template by template ID
GetDataQualityTemplate.description_zh: 根据ID查询指定的数据质量规则模板详情

GetDataSource.description_en: Queries a specified data source by data source ID
GetDataSource.description_zh: 根据数据源ID，查询指定的数据源

GetDatabase.description_en: Queries the information about a specific database in Data Map
GetDatabase.description_zh: 获取数据地图给定数据库的详情信息

GetDataset.description_en: Gets the details of a dataset
GetDataset.description_zh: 获取数据集的详细信息

GetDatasetVersion.description_en: Gets information for a given dataset version
GetDatasetVersion.description_zh: 获取给定数据集版本信息

GetDeploymentPackage.description_en: Retrieves the details of a deployment package
GetDeploymentPackage.description_zh: 调用GetDeploymentPackage获取发布包的详情

GetFile.description_en: Retrieves the details of a file
GetFile.description_zh: 该接口用于获取文件的详情

GetFileVersion.description_en: Retrieves the version details of a file
GetFileVersion.description_zh: 调用GetFileVersion获取文件的版本详情

GetFolder.description_en: Queries the information about a folder
GetFolder.description_zh: 调用GetFolder获取文件夹的详情

GetFunction.description_en: Queries the information about a user-defined function (UDF) in DataStudio
GetFunction.description_zh: 获取指定数据开发udf函数的详细信息

GetIDEEventDetail.description_en: Queries the data snapshot of an extension point based on the ID of a message in DataWorks OpenEvent when the related extension point event is triggered
GetIDEEventDetail.description_zh: 根据DataWorks开放消息的消息ID，查询触发扩展点事件时的扩展点数据快照

GetImage.description_en: Retrieves the details of a specified image by image ID

ListWorkflows.description_en: Queries a list of workflows by page. You can also specify filter conditions to query workflows
ListWorkflows.description_zh: 分页获取工作流列表，也可以通过条件进行筛选查询

LoadAgentSession.description_en: Loads the message history of an existing session and returns it as an SSE stream. If the session does not exist, the server sends a JSONRPCResponse.error with a code of 400 through the SSE stream. The Content-Type is text/event-stream. Use this operation to restore session context
LoadAgentSession.description_zh: 加载已存在会话的历史消息，以 SSE 流式返回。会话不存在时会通过 SSE 输出一条 code 为 400 的 JSONRPCResponse.error。Content-Type 为 text/event-stream。适用于恢复会话上下文场景

MoveFunction.description_en: Moves a user-defined function (UDF) to a path in DataStudio
MoveFunction.description_zh: 调用此接口，可以将指定udf函数移动到数据开发目录的目标路径

MoveNode.description_en: Moves a node to a path in DataStudio
MoveNode.description_zh: 调用此接口，可以将指定的数据开发节点的路径移动到指定位置

MoveResource.description_en: Moves a file resource to a path in DataStudio
MoveResource.description_zh: 调用此接口，可以将指定数据开发文件资源移动到指定的数据开发目录中

MoveWorkflowDefinition.description_en: Moves a workflow to a path in DataStudio
MoveWorkflowDefinition.description_zh: 调用此接口，可以将指定的数据开发工作流移动到数据开发目录的目标路径

PreviewDatasetVersion.description_en: Previews the content of a specified dataset version. Currently only text file preview is supported for OSS-type datasets. Supported MIME types 1. application/json 2. application/xml 3. text/html 4. text/plain 5. application/octet-stream
PreviewDatasetVersion.description_zh:
预览指定版本数据集内容，当前仅支持OSS类型数据集下文本文件预览
当前支持的MIME类型有
application/json
application/xml
text/html
text/plain
application/octet-stream

PromptAgentSession.description_en: Sends a user prompt to an existing session and returns the Agent response in streaming mode
PromptAgentSession.description_zh: 向已有会话发送用户Prompt并流式返回Agent响应

RemoveEntityFromMetaCollection.description_en:
Remove an entity object from a Data Map collection. The collection supports Data Map categories and data albums, and the entity currently supports only the Data Table type.
When removing an entity from a data album, the caller must have the AliyunDataWorksFullAccess permission or be the creator or administrator of the album
RemoveEntityFromMetaCollection.description_zh:
从数据地图集合中移除实体对象，集合支持数据地图类目和数据专辑，实体当前仅支持数据表类型。
从数据专辑移除实体时，要求调用者具有AliyunDataWorksFullAccess 权限，或者为专辑的创建者或管理员

RemoveTaskInstanceDependencies.description_en: Removes multiple upstream dependencies of an instance at a time
RemoveTaskInstanceDependencies.description_zh: 批量移除某任务实例的多个上游依赖关系

RenameFunction.description_en: Renames a user-defined function (UDF) in DataStudio
RenameFunction.description_zh: 调用此接口，可以对指定的udf函数进行重命名

RenameNode.description_zh: 调用此接口，可以重命名数据开发节点

RenameResource.description_en: Renames a file resource in DataStudio
RenameResource.description_zh: 调用此接口，可以对数据开发文件资源进行重命名

RenameWorkflowDefinition.description_zh: 调用此接口，可以重命名数据开发工作流

RerunTaskInstances.description_en: Reruns multiple node instances in a batch
RerunTaskInstances.description_zh: 批量重跑多个任务实例

ResumeTaskInstances.description_en: Resumes multiple suspended instances at a time
ResumeTaskInstances.description_zh: 批量恢复多个已暂停的任务实例

RevokeMemberProjectRoles.description_en: Revokes roles from a workspace member
RevokeMemberProjectRoles.description_zh: 撤销工作空间成员的角色

RunCrawler.description_en: Triggers a specified metadata crawler to run and returns the submit status and associated task instance information
RunCrawler.description_zh: 触发指定元数据采集器运行，并返回受理状态和关联的任务实例信息

RunSemanticJob.description_en: Submits a saved semantic job for execution by name and returns the run and executor identifiers. A successful call indicates that the job has been submitted, not that the semantic model results have been generated
RunSemanticJob.description_zh: 按已创建任务的 Name 提交执行并返回本次运行与执行器标识。调用成功表示已提交，不代表语义模型结果已经生成

SetSuccessTaskInstances.description_en: Sets the statuses of multiple instances to successful at a time
SetSuccessTaskInstances.description_zh: 批量置成功多个任务实例

StartDIJob.description_zh: 启动数据集成新版任务

StartServerIdeInstance.description_en: Starts a specified personal development environment instance
StartServerIdeInstance.description_zh: 启动指定的个人开发环境实例

StartWorkflowInstances.description_en: Starts multiple workflow instances in a batch
StartWorkflowInstances.description_zh: 批量启动多个工作流实例

StopCrawler.description_en: Stops the currently running task of a specified metadata crawler
StopCrawler.description_zh: 停止指定元数据采集器当前正在执行的运行任务

StopProcessInstance.description_en: Withdraws or terminates a specified process instance
StopProcessInstance.description_zh: 用于撤回或终止指定的审批流程实例

StopServerIdeInstance.description_en: Stops a specified personal development environment instance
StopServerIdeInstance.description_zh: 停止指定的个人开发环境实例

StopTaskInstances.description_en: Stops multiple instances in a batch
StopTaskInstances.description_zh: 批量终止多个任务实例

StopWorkflowInstances.description_en: Stops multiple workflow instances at a time
StopWorkflowInstances.description_zh: 批量终止多个工作流实例

SubmitBatchChangeTableOwner.description_en: Submits a batch request to transfer table ownership

SubmitFile.description_en: Commits a file to the development environment of the scheduling system to generate a task
SubmitFile.description_zh: 提交文件至调度系统的开发环境，生成对应的任务

SuspendTaskInstances.description_en: Suspends multiple instances at a time
SuspendTaskInstances.description_zh: 批量暂停多个任务实例

TestDataSourceConnectivity.description_en: Test the connectivity of a data source on a resource group
TestDataSourceConnectivity.description_zh: 测试数据源在资源组上的连通性

TriggerSchedulerTaskInstance.description_en: Triggers a task to run by using an HTTP Trigger node at a specified time
TriggerSchedulerTaskInstance.description_zh: 在某个定时时间，触发指定HTTP触发器调度任务运行

UnTagDataAssets.description_zh: 为数据资产解绑标签关系

UpdateAlertRule.description_en: Updates the information about a custom alert monitoring rule
UpdateAlertRule.description_zh: 更新自定义监控告警规则

UpdateBusiness.description_zh: 该接口用于更新业务流程

UpdateColumnBusinessMetadata.description_en: Updates the business metadata for a column in a data map. This operation can only update the business description and custom attributes
UpdateColumnBusinessMetadata.description_zh: 更新数据地图数据表给定字段的业务元数据，当前仅支持更新字段的业务描述和自定义属性

UpdateComputeResource.description_en: Modifies the specified computing resource based on the computing resource ID
UpdateComputeResource.description_zh: 根据计算资源ID，修改指定的计算资源

UpdateCrawler.description_en: Updates the resource group, collection scope, scheduling, and extension configurations of a specified metadata crawler
UpdateCrawler.description_zh: 更新指定元数据采集器的资源组、采集范围、调度和扩展配置

UpdateDIAlarmRule.description_en: Updates an alert rule configured for a synchronization task
UpdateDIAlarmRule.description_zh: 更新数据集成报警规则

UpdateDataQualityAlertRule.description_en: Updates a specified data quality monitoring alert rule
UpdateDataQualityAlertRule.description_zh: 用于更新指定的数据质量监控告警规则

UpdateDataQualityEvaluationTask.description_en: Updates a data quality validation task
UpdateDataQualityEvaluationTask.description_zh: 更新数据质量校验任务

UpdateDataQualityRuleTemplate.description_en: Updates a data quality rule template

UpdateDataQualityTemplate.description_en: Updates a data quality rule template in a project
UpdateDataQualityTemplate.description_zh: 用于更新指定项目下的数据质量规则模板配置

UpdateDataSource.description_en: Modifies a data source by ID
UpdateDataSource.description_zh: 根据数据源ID，修改指定的数据源

UpdateDataset.description_en: Updates dataset information. Only DataWorks datasets are supported. The operator must be the creator of the dataset or the administrator of the workspace where the dataset is located
UpdateDataset.description_zh: 更新数据集信息，仅支持DataWorks数据集，要求操作者为数据集的创建者或数据集所在工作空间的管理员

UpdateDatasetVersion.description_en: Updates dataset version information. Only DataWorks datasets are supported. Requires dataset creator or workspace administrator permissions
UpdateDatasetVersion.description_zh: 更新数据集版本信息，仅支持DataWorks数据集，要求操作者为数据集的创建者或数据集所在工作空间的管理员

UpdateFile.description_zh: 调用UpdateFile更新已创建的文件

UpdateFolder.description_en: Invoke UpdateFolder to update the folder information
UpdateFolder.description_zh: 调用UpdateFolder更新文件夹的信息

UpdateFunction.description_en: Updates the basic information about a user-defined function (UDF) in DataStudio. This API operation performs an incremental update. The update information is described by using FlowSpec
UpdateFunction.description_zh: 调用此接口，可以更新udf函数信息。更新以增量更新的方式进行，更新信息通过FlowSpec格式描述

UpdateIDEEventResult.description_en: Returns the check result of an extension point event message
UpdateIDEEventResult.description_zh: 回调扩展点消息的检查结果

UpdateMetaCollection.description_en:
Update Data Map collection objects, including Data Map categories and data albums. You can update the collection name, description, and administrator information.
When updating a data album, the caller must have the AliyunDataWorksFullAccess permission or be the creator or an administrator of the album
UpdateMetaCollection.description_zh:
更新数据地图集合对象，包括数据地图类目和数据专辑，支持更新集合名称，描述和管理员信息。
更新数据专辑时，要求调用者具有AliyunDataWorksFullAccess 权限，或者为专辑的创建者或管理员

UpdateMetaEntity.description_en: Updates a metadata entity. You can update custom entities or objects of the extended table type, such as databases, tables, and columns
UpdateMetaEntity.description_zh: 更新元数据实体，支持更新创建的自定义类型对象或者扩展表对象（Database/Table/Column）

UpdateMetaEntityDef.description_en: Updates a metadata entity definition, including custom entity types and extension table types
UpdateMetaEntityDef.description_zh: 更新元数据实体定义（包含纯自定义类型和扩展表类型）

UpdateNode.description_en: Updates the basic information about a node in DataStudio. This API operation performs an incremental update. The update information is described by using FlowSpec
UpdateNode.description_zh: 调用此接口，可以更新数据开发节点信息。更新通过增量更新的方式进行，更新的信息通过FlowSpec进行描述

UpdateParameter.description_en: Updates a parameter. This operation performs an incremental update and modifies only the specified fields
UpdateParameter.description_zh: 更新参数。增量修改，只修改指定的字段

UpdateProcessDefinition.description_en: Updates an existing approval process definition
UpdateProcessDefinition.description_zh: 用于更新已有的审批流程定义信息

UpdateProject.description_en: This operation updates a DataWorks workspace
UpdateProject.description_zh: 该接口用于更新DataWorks工作空间

UpdateProjectRole.description_en: Updates the permissions of a custom role in a workspace
UpdateProjectRole.description_zh: 更新空间自定义角色权限

UpdateResource.description_en: Updates the basic information about a file resource in DataStudio. This API operation performs an incremental update. The update information is described by using FlowSpec
UpdateResource.description_zh: 调用此接口，可以更新数据开发文件资源的基本信息。更新以增量更新的方式进行，更新信息以FlowSpec格式描述

UpdateResourceGroup.description_en: Updates basic information about a resource group

UpdateRoute.description_en: Updates the information about a route

UpdateSecurityStrategy.description_en: To modify the configuration of an existing security policy, you must be both a DataWorks tenant administrator and a security administrator
UpdateSecurityStrategy.description_zh: 用于修改现有安全策略的配置信息。需要Dataworks 租户管理员与安全管理员权限

UpdateServerIdeInstance.description_en: Updates the configuration of a specified personal development environment instance
UpdateServerIdeInstance.description_zh: 更新指定个人开发环境实例的配置

UpdateSkill.description_en: Updates a specified Skill and generates a new version
UpdateSkill.description_zh: 用于更新指定的Skill并生成新版本

UpdateTableBusinessMetadata.description_en: Updates the business metadata of a table in Data Map. Currently, only the table usage description and custom attributes can be updated
UpdateTableBusinessMetadata.description_zh: 更新数据地图数据表的业务元数据，当前仅支持更新表的使用说明和自定义属性

UpdateTask.description_en: Updates a specified node. The modifications are synchronized to DataStudio, where a new saved version is created
UpdateTask.description_zh: 更新指定任务。修改的内容会同步到数据开发，数据开发将新增一个保存版本

UpdateTaskInstances.description_en: Modify the properties of multiple task instances in batch, including priority, resource group, data source, and more
UpdateTaskInstances.description_zh: 批量修改多个任务实例的属性，包括优先级、调度资源组、数据源等

UpdateUdfFile.description_en: Updates the file information about a function
UpdateUdfFile.description_zh: 调用UpdateUdfFile更新函数的文件信息

UpdateWorkflow.description_en: Updates a specified workflow by using the full update method. Fields that can be synchronously updated to DataStudio include: owner, data source, schedule resource group, description, and trigger run mode (Normal, Skip, or Pause)
UpdateWorkflow.description_zh: 以全量更新的方式，更新指定工作流。支持同步更新到数据开发的字段：责任人、数据源、调度资源组、描述信息、触发运行模式（正常、空跑、暂停）

UpdateWorkflowDefinition.description_en: Updates the basic information about a workflow in DataStudio. This API operation performs an incremental update. The update information is described by using FlowSpec
UpdateWorkflowDefinition.description_zh: 调用此接口，可以更新数据开发工作流基本信息。更新以增量更新的方式进行，更新信息以FlowSpec格式描述

UploadSemanticFile.description_en: Requests a temporary OSS PUT upload URL. Complete the PUT upload before the URL expires, then pass the returned FileId to the ReferenceFileIds parameter of CreateSemanticJob
UploadSemanticFile.description_zh: 申请临时 OSS PUT 上传地址后，先在有效期内完成 PUT 上传，再将返回的 FileId 填入 CreateSemanticJob 的 ReferenceFileIds
